heldWriting.title: I waited for sorry
heldWriting.content:
He bumped my cheek and pulled his claws inside.

I leaned closer. His eyes disappeared too.

I waited for sorry. He stayed in there.

Backed away in disgust. Out came his feelers, then his eyes.

I tried hello from there. He came all the way out.
